\usepackage{xurl}
\usepackage{fvextra}

% xurl's default is break-anywhere (letters included). Restrict to path punctuation.
% Zero muskip so TeX can still break at those chars without stretching
% "financeMD / damodaran" or "ValIntroSpr25 . md" in justified text.
\makeatletter
\def\UrlBreaks{\do\/\do\_\do\-\do\.}
\def\UrlBigBreaks{\do\/}
\Urlmuskip=0mu
\@ifundefined{LTleft}{}{\setlength{\LTleft}{0pt}}
\makeatother

\fvset{breaklines=true,breakanywhere=false,breakafter={/._-}}
\emergencystretch=3em
\RecustomVerbatimEnvironment{verbatim}{Verbatim}{breaklines=true,breakanywhere=false,breakafter={/._-},fontsize=\small}

% Helvetica Neue ligates "ff"; names like fcffsimpleginzu must stay letter-for-letter.
\setmainfont{Helvetica Neue}[Ligatures=NoCommon]
\setmonofont{Menlo}[Ligatures=NoCommon]

% unicode-math turns the math colon into U+2236, which Helvetica Neue and Menlo lack,
% so every ":" inside \url and \nolinkurl vanished. Typeset it as a text colon instead.
\makeatletter
\g@addto@macro\UrlSpecials{\do\:{\mbox{:}\allowbreak}}
\makeatother
